name: Hybrid Volume and Isosurface Rendering with Partial Pre-Integration
definition: A hybrid volume and isosurface rendering method that combines direct volume rendering with multiple isosurfaces, using partial preintegration to achieve interactive frame rates by eliminating bus transfer overhead.
summary: PTINT is a GPU-accelerated cell projection method combining volume rendering with isosurfaces, distinguished by eliminating bus transfer overhead and requiring no cell connectivity.
